description: This file defines the TaxService interface, which declares methods for retrieving, saving, and calculating tax configurations related to orders and merchant stores in an e-commerce application.

classes.name: TaxService
classes.description: Interface for tax-related operations, including retrieving configurations, saving configurations, and calculating taxes for orders.

methods.name: getTaxConfiguration
methods.description: Retrieves tax configuration settings for a specific merchant store.

methods.name: saveTaxConfiguration
methods.description: Saves the tax configuration for a merchant store.

methods.name: calculateTax
methods.description: Calculates tax items for a given order summary, customer, store, and language.
